COMPANY PROFILE

Sourcing & verifying
steel and industrial products.

TIANJIN DECENT INTERNATIONAL TRADE CO., LTD. is a professional industrial trading company based in Tianjin, China, backed by many years of experience in the steel and construction materials industry.

Managing supplier compliance and quality audits at the source.

Operating from the primary industrial corridors of China, we bridge the gap between heavy-duty metallurgical fabrication and global construction project specifications. Our focus centers on direct supply logistics, third-party laboratory tests, and mill certificate verification.

Because scaffolding structures bear human lives and vertical structural loads, we treat quality inspections as an absolute duty rather than a marketing checkbox. Every batch is measured for wall thickness, tensile limits, and galvanization density before loading.

TD-03.A // COMPLIANCE PRINCIPLES

Core assurances.

Our commitments governing every transaction and dispatch manifest.

01 // INTEGRITY

Technical precision.

We align sales parameters directly with physical engineering tolerances. We measure wall thicknesses, locking welds, and slip resistances to the millimeter.

02 // VERIFICATION

Quality testing.

From raw metallurgical batch testing to third-party certifications (MTC), every step is checked and verified prior to container dispatch at Port of Tianjin.

03 // RELIABILITY

Supply continuity.

Clear packaging lists, certified weights, structured vessel booking, and transparent billing. We build long-term B2B partnerships with no exaggerated claims.
